environment.description: Container deployed via Kubernetes with Pod Security Standard 'restricted' profile enforced at namespace level. Container rootfs mounted read-only (readOnlyRootFilesystem: true in securityContext). No tmpfs, emptyDir, or PVC volumes mounted. The SQL Server connection uses a database user provisioned with DENY EXECUTE permission and restricted to a single schema (catalog) with column-level SELECT grants only on Products(Id, Name, Price, Description). The database user has no permissions on INFORMATION_SCHEMA, sys tables, or any other schema. Additionally, SQL Server Resource Governor limits the user's session to a workload group with REQUEST_MAX_CPU_TIME_SEC=2 and REQUEST_MEMORY_GRANT_TIMEOUT_SEC=1, preventing time-based blind injection techniques from completing.

config.volumes: none - no emptyDir, tmpfs, or PVC
config.database_user_permissions: GRANT SELECT (Id, Name, Price, Description) ON catalog.Products; DENY EXECUTE TO app_reader; DENY SELECT ON SCHEMA::sys TO app_reader; DENY SELECT ON SCHEMA::INFORMATION_SCHEMA TO app_reader; DENY VIEW ANY DATABASE TO app_reader
